name: Negative and Error Handling Testing
purpose: Identify negative, invalid, rejected, and failure-path test scenarios that are directly supported by the provided requirements.

apply_when: The requirement defines an invalid input condition.
The requirement defines a rejection condition.
The requirement defines an error condition.
The requirement defines a failure response.
The requirement defines an unavailable dependency.
The requirement defines a timeout or retry behavior.
The requirement defines an unsuccessful workflow outcome.
do_not_apply_when: The failure behavior is not supported by the supplied requirements.
The expected error behavior would have to be invented.
The system dependency or failure condition is not relevant to the requirement.

coverage_dimensions.name: Invalid Input
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify explicitly defined invalid inputs are rejected correctly.

coverage_dimensions.name: Missing Input
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify behavior when an explicitly required input is missing.

coverage_dimensions.name: Rejected Operation
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify an operation that the requirement explicitly says must be rejected.

coverage_dimensions.name: Invalid State
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify behavior when an explicitly unsupported state is encountered.

coverage_dimensions.name: Dependency Failure
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify behavior when a required dependency is unavailable, only when such dependency behavior is relevant and supported.

coverage_dimensions.name: Timeout
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify timeout behavior when a timeout requirement or dependency timeout behavior is explicitly defined.

coverage_dimensions.name: Retry
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify retry behavior only when retry behavior is explicitly defined.

coverage_dimensions.name: Graceful Failure
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify the system fails gracefully when graceful failure behavior is explicitly required.

coverage_dimensions.name: Error Recovery
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify recovery after a defined error or failure condition.

coverage_dimensions.name: Repeated Failure
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify repeated failure behavior only when the requirement defines a rule related to repeated failures.

when_explicitly_defined: Use the exact expected behavior from the requirement.
when_not_defined: Use 'Requires QA Input' where an expected behavior is necessary but unspecified.
Do not silently invent an error message or system response.

examples.requirement: The system rejects an invalid email address.
If the authentication service is unavailable, the application displays a service-unavailable message.
applicable_scenarios: Application displays the specified service-unavailable behavior

unknown_information.rule: Missing failure behavior must be reported rather than invented.
